title: Number of Cases of Dengue Inspection Officers being Refused Entry into Homes and Penalties Meted Out
what_it_is: Number of Cases of Dengue Inspection Officers being Refused Entry into Homes and Penalties Meted Out

sections.label: Refused entry inspection attempts
sections.summary: NEA encountered about six instances of refused entry for every 100 inspection attempts at residential premises in the past three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for
sentences.text: In the past three years, NEA has encountered about six instances of refused entry for every 100 inspection attempts at residential premises.

sections.label: Control of Vectors Act penalties
sections.summary: Under the CVPA, notices may be served on those who repeatedly refuse entry, with fines up to $5,000 or three months' imprisonment, but no one has been charged in three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for
sentences.text: Under the Control of Vectors and Pesticides Act 1998 (CVPA), notices to require residents to make their premises available for inspection may be served to those who repeatedly refuse entry to NEA inspection officers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for
sentences.text: Offenders are liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $5,000 or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding three months, or to both.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for
sentences.text: We have not had the need to charge anyone under section 45 for repeated refusal to entry in the past three years and we do not have any plans to increase the penalties at this point in time.

sections.label: People refusing NEA inspections
sections.summary: People who refused entry for NEA inspections span a wide spectrum, with no predominance of senior citizens.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: People who refused entry for NEA inspections span across a wide spectrum and there is no predominance of senior citizens.

sections.label: Verifying NEA officer identity
sections.summary: NEA officers wear polo t-shirts and carry authority cards, and residents can verify identity by calling the NEA contact centre at 6225 5632.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Besides the NEA polo t-shirts that the officers wear, they also carry an authority card that residents can check against.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: They can verify the identity of the officers by calling the NEA contact centre at 6225 5632.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Our officers will also share these verification methods with residents who raise any concerns about their authenticity, and we will continue to raise awareness of our dengue officers' work through periodic outreach.
